kitDescription: Diesel: Winter Sweets is a Fire rocket-launcher Attacker (Burst III) whose damage comes almost entirely from damage-over-time rather than from her rockets. The first time she enters Full Burst she locks into one of two states — Intro if she used her own Burst going in, Highlight if she did not — and either way she permanently gains +20.28% Critical Damage; the state decides how hard her damage-over-time is amplified for the next 10 seconds, a modest +60.19% in Intro versus a huge +235.03% in Highlight. Every fully charged rocket she fires adds another +318.14% sustained-damage boost for 3 seconds, up to two stacks, so mid-magazine she is roughly tripling that amplifier again. Her actual damage arrives as ticking burns: 63.33% of her ATK per second for 9 seconds on every Full Burst, plus — from her own Burst — 18.43% and 181.2% per second for 9 seconds on the boss, alongside a team-wide +25.09% Damage Taken debuff that makes every ally's hits land harder. In the Highlight state her Burst also briefly blinds her allies (Hit Rate ▼100% for 1 second) unless they have built Mute stacks by destroying enemy parts — a downside that never arises on a boss with no destructible parts.

redAssertions: S1c/S1d 'Intro 60.19% and Highlight 235.03% are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE in both fixtures' — passes in the sole-B3 fixture (Intro-only), FAILS in the two-B3 (helm) fixture where the driver's per-rotation ownBurstGate alternates the tiers (6 Intro on her casts / 5 Highlight on helm's) instead of latching one tier for the whole fight. Classification: a REAL, DOCUMENTED divergence (driver flag1), not a blind misread — the prose's 'for the first time' IS a once-per-battle latch and the engine has no latch primitive. Every other blind assertion (16, incl. S1d 'the Highlight branch EXISTS and is gate-suppressed, not dropped') passes UNMODIFIED against the shipped override; 2 are the blind writer's own GAP skips (Mute immunity, Mute-stack decrement).

gotchas.summary: Intro/Highlight is a once-per-battle LATCH in the prose ('for the first time') but ownBurstGate is a PER-ROTATION gate, so on any rotation she skips her burst the tier flips 60.19 → 235.03 (a ~4× swing on her entire sustained bucket).
gotchas.evidence: Kit: '■ Activates when entering Full Burst for the first time after using Burst Skill' / '…for the first time without using own Burst Skill', both 'continuously / cannot be removed / persists after revival' — an irrevocable status. Engine types.ts:357-368: ownBurstGate is 'checked when the trigger fires', evaluated against the rotationCasters set per Full Burst; no latch primitive exists. Driver flag1 + caveat 1 record this; S2b named it the #1 shared-prior misread and wrote the killer assertion; the S5 blind test's per-fight mutual-exclusivity assertion is RED against the shipped override in the two-B3 fixture (6 Intro + 5 Highlight alternating over 11 FB entries) — behavior a true latch would never produce.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Keep the shipped ownBurstGate encoding — it is exact on both clean domains (always-burst ⇒ Intro every FB; never-burst comp N5 ⇒ Highlight every FB) and it is what fixes the confirmed 0.793 COLD. Before relying on it, VERIFY the inertness premise rather than assuming it: for every graded comp containing diesel-winter-sweets, read the rotation log and confirm she either casts into EVERY Full Burst or into NONE. If any graded comp has her casting intermittently, this is a live over-credit and the faithful fix is a once-per-battle latch primitive (e.g. a 'first-fire-only' gate that snapshots ownBurstGate at the first fullBurstEnter and pins the block's disposition for the rest of the fight) — never a magnitude tweak to split the difference between the tiers.

gotchas.summary: Highlight's ally cost (Noise Pollution, Hit Rate ▼100% for 1s) is unmodelable in the engine's hitRatePct channel and is documented rather than encoded, so a mixed comp that both grants the 235.03 tier and casts her burst would carry the upside without the downside.
gotchas.evidence: Kit: '■ Activates while the skill user is in Highlight status. Affects all allies (except self). Noise Pollution: Hit Rate ▼ 100% for 1 sec.' Engine/game-mechanics.md §7: hitRatePct drives R(hr) = (CIRCLE_PX_K·scale_w/2)(1 − hr/100), the accuracy-circle radius — at −100 the circle doubles rather than the allies missing outright, a different and much smaller mechanic. Driver documents it (unmodeled.burst verbatim + caveat 4 + flag2); the S6 blind encoded −100 anyway, which is the less faithful of the two options.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Leave unmodeled while every graded Highlight comp is a never-burst comp (the cost then genuinely does not occur in game either). If a comp where she is Highlight AND casts her burst is ever graded, add a real hit-rate clamp/zero primitive (allies deal no weapon damage for 1s, per ally, unless Mute-immune) — needs measurement of the in-game 1s blank window from footage; do NOT approximate it with a negative hitRatePct.

verdictRationale: GO. All 12 kit lines are FAITHFUL (8) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (4) — 1.0 — and the revision is a genuine fidelity gain, not a re-labelling: modeling BOTH sustained tiers via ownBurstGate ('cast' 60.19 / 'notCast' 235.03) on fullBurstEnter is the engine's own canonical encoding for this exact line (types.ts:368) and it repairs the confirmed root cause of her 0.793 COLD on the never-burst comp N5, which the previous Intro-only encoding could not express at any magnitude. Convergence is honestly RED, not green: 16 of the S5 blind's assertions (including S1d, the Highlight-branch existence check that failed last run) pass UNMODIFIED, but the per-fight mutual-exclusivity assertion fails in the artificial two-B3 fixture, and that RED is REAL rather than a blind misread — the prose's 'for the first time' is a once-per-battle latch and the engine has no latch primitive, so the shipped gate re-decides the tier every rotation. That is gotcha 1, documented as flag1, and it is the single thing standing between this override and full prose fidelity; it is inert on both clean graded domains (always-burst ⇒ Intro; never-burst ⇒ Highlight) and therefore not GO-blocking. The three agents converge line-for-line on everything else (S2 63.33 FB DoT; the additive 18.43 + 181.2 burst DoTs on the solo boss; the 25.09 boss-side Damage Taken team amp; both part-gated lines unmodeled), and the two residual driver/blind differences both resolve in the driver's favour on the formula SSOT: hitRatePct −100 would model a doubled aim circle, not 'miss everything' (S6's encoding is the fudge, the driver's documentation is correct), and the 318.14 stack pair provably LAPSES across the 3.35s reload+charge gap (S2b's prediction, confirmed empirically by the driver's run), refuting S6's 'stacks survive the reload' flag. Bucket routing is verified rather than asserted: all three big sustained buffs are sustainedDamagePct, and the driver's D-scope counterfactual proves her RL normal bucket is byte-identical with them removed while her DoT total drops — the attackDamagePct misread is excluded. Discrimination holds on every load-bearing line, with one stated coverage limit: in the sole-B3 fixture burstCast and fullBurstEnter coincide, so the burst block's trigger is pinned structurally (it would still go RED under a fullBurstEnter counterfactual) rather than behaviorally. SAME-MODEL RESIDUALS FOR THE OWNER (S5/S6/S7 are all claude-opus-5; only S2b is cross-family): (1) the load-bearing premise that 'the graded comps are clean' is asserted by the driver and NOT verifiable from this packet — read the rotation log of every graded comp containing her and confirm she casts into all Full Bursts or none, because an intermittent-burst comp turns gotcha 1 into a live ~4× over-credit on her whole sustained bucket; (2) the ⚑ RL cadence tuple (chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141) is unverified datamine and sets both her shot count and the 318.14 stack duty cycle — a focus-video rounds/min + reload-gap read pins it; (3) the burst DoTs' first tick lands pre-Full-Burst by the 22f rule while ticks 2-9 land inside it, which is the default FB-by-landing-timing behavior and correctly carries no per-kit noFb without measurement.
